published_statement: Gao & Wald 2000 (READ, cached): 'if we define the matrix A^mu_nu(lambda) by d^2A^mu_nu/dlambda^2 = -Sum R_{alpha beta sigma}^mu k^alpha k^sigma A^beta_nu (11) with initial conditions A^mu_nu|p = 0 and (dA^mu_nu/dlambda)|p = delta^mu_nu, then q will be conjugate to p if and only if det A = 0 at q. We define G(lambda) = sqrt(det A(lambda)) (12) ... the Raychaudhuri equation yields G''/G = -(1/2)[sigma_ab sigma^ab + R_ab k^a k^b] (13) where sigma_ab denotes the shear of the congruence of null geodesics emanating from p.' Kar & SenGupta 2006 (READ, cached) p.13 eq.(17), attributed to 'Sachs [9] in 1961': 'dTheta/dlambda + (1/2)Theta^2 + sigma^2 - omega^2 = -R_ab k^a k^b', with 'affine parametrisation ... k_a k^a = 0 and k_a xi^a = 0' and an auxiliary null N^a, k_a N^a = -1, transverse metric h_ab = g_ab + k_a N_b + k_b N_a; timelike shear eq.(13): 'dsigma_ab/dlambda = ... + C_cbad v^c v^d + (1/2) R~_ab' -- the Weyl tensor sources shear; 'these are not equations but, essentially, identities'. Standard content (Sachs 1961, NAMED-NOT-READ; proved in the sibling V1 and re-derived here J1-J2): the optical tidal matrix T_ij = R_{a b c d} e_i^a k^b e_j^c k^d on an orthonormal screen orthogonal to null k has tr T = R_kk (Ricci focusing, first order, sign-bearing) and trace-free part = Weyl (shear-sourcing: astigmatic, and it focuses the area only at second order through sigma^2, which is sign-definite).
published_hypotheses: k NULL, affinely parametrised geodesic tangent (Kar-SenGupta p.13: 'affine parametrisation ... k_a k^a = 0'); the screen trace equals R_kk only for null k
screen {e1, e2} orthonormal, orthogonal to k (and to an auxiliary null N, k.N = -1), parallel-transported along the ray
4D Lorentzian metric, Levi-Civita connection (the trace/trace-free split is pure algebra of the Riemann symmetries; the evolution equations are 'identities', Kar-SenGupta p.11)
congruence from a point p (Gao-Wald initial data A|p = 0, A'|p = delta), hence twist-free (omega = 0)
'vacuum => traceless' needs an EXACT solution of R_ab = 0 (or R_ab = Lambda g_ab); the conclusion is exact, not to an order
sign convention: Gao-Wald's R_{alpha beta sigma}^mu (Wald) with A'' = -R A; in MTW convention D^2 xi/dlambda^2 = -R^a_{bcd} k^b xi^c k^d, i.e. A'' = -T_MTW A with T_MTW as above
hypothesis_drift: DROPPED: null k in the vacuum test. concentric.trace_ratio (concentric.py:186) evaluates the tidal matrix with k = [1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], which in the tree's metric has g(k,k) = -4 Phi = -1.99e-2 at (0,1,0), m = 5e-3 (J4). On an exactly null k with orthonormal screen and exact Riemann of the same linearised metric, |trace|/|max| at a = 0.02 is 7.32e-3, not 7.55e-4 (J4). The tree's 7.55e-4 (quoted at concentric.py:106, 292 'to better than a tenth of a percent', 356 VERDICT 'traceless to 7.5e-4') is reproduced exactly (7.5468e-4), and equals, to 3.4 %, the O(m) Plummer-density term alone (2|lap Phi| / T_max = 7.81e-4): the non-null-k term cancels the linearised metric's own O(m^2) trace. So the 7.5e-4 is a recipe-dependent figure, not a measurement of 'how empty the corridor is' (concentric.py:183-184). At a = 0.5 and 0.1 the density term dominates on either recipe (0.399 vs 0.404; 1.97e-2 vs 2.62e-2) and the monotone conclusion 'compact core => vacuum corridor, b/a >~ 50' (concentric.py:105-111) STANDS as a statement about the core's density.

WEAKENED, NAMED: exact vacuum -> linearised weak field (named by the tree, concentric.py:139-141 'LINEARISED WEAK FIELD ... INDICATIVE'). Consequence computed (J2, symbolic): the linearised metric's null-screen trace at closest approach is 2 lap(Phi) at O(m) (density: -6 a^2 m/(a^2+b^2)^(5/2)) plus -4 m^2/b^4 at O(m^2) (a = 0), i.e. 4m/(3b) = 6.67e-3 of the Weyl part at m = 5e-3 -- about 8.5x the density term at a = 0.02. The a = 0.02 corridor is therefore limited by the linearisation, not by the core, at the 7e-3 level; this sits inside the tree's named limitation 2 but is not what 'traceless to 7.5e-4' says.

SIGN CONVENTION (discrepancy, concentric.py:207-208 via composite.tidal): composite.tidal returns -T_MTW (J5: tree T_yy = -1.50301e-2, MTW +1.50300e-2 at (0,1,0), a = 0.02), and survey integrates A'' = -T_tree A = +T_MTW A, the opposite of the Jacobi equation. Because T is traceless at O(m) the conjugate points barely move: re-run in an independent integrator the tree's sign reproduces the tree's 228.45 (228.482) while the correct sign gives 228.684, and geodesic-bundle truth (neighbour ray from the source point, perturbed 1e-6 rad) is 228.732; shifts -0.202, -0.095, -0.059, -0.034, +0.004 at m = 5e-3 ... 8e-2 (J6). The tree's 'conjugate point sits at 228.45 +- 0.04 over n = 1500 to 9000' (concentric.py:79-80) is numerically converged but 0.28 (7x the quoted +-0.04) from the true caustic of its own metric; every shift is < 0.1 % and no seat/no-seat verdict changes. Same finding as the sibling audit for composite.py (vacuum-ricci-flat-traceless-tidal.json, V5).

MINOR, no effect: screen e1, e2 = coordinate vectors (concentric.py:197), not unit (g(e,e) = 1 - 2 Phi(x0), Phi(x0) ~ 8e-6) and transported by first-order Euler (concentric.py:215-220). The independent RK4 orthonormal integration with the tree's sign gives 228.482 against the tree's own 228.480 (J6), so these contribute ~0.002.

PRECISION NOTE, not a drift: 'Weyl focusing is quadratic in the source' (concentric.py:6-7) is exact for the AREA: for traceless K, det(lam I - K) = lam^2 - k1^2 - k2^2 with no linear term and invariant under K -> -K (J1), i.e. Gao-Wald eq.(13)'s sigma^2. The conjugate point itself is reached at first order in the focal power 4|m|/b^2 (thin-lens 150 + (1/f - 1/150)^-1 = 225.0, 180.0, 163.6, 156.5, 153.2 vs integrated 228.7, 182.3, 165.4, 158.1, 154.5). 'Sign-blind' follows from tracelessness (J1) and is correct.

STANDS: 'THE SHELL DELAYS BUT DOES NOT FOCUS' (concentric.py:57-60). A constant Phi gives an identically zero Riemann tensor (J3), and adding the interior constant c = -m/R_s to the core changes the tidal matrix by 8.5e-5 relative, O(m c) (J3); the ray stays inside the shell (max_r < 200). The exact-GR statement (Birkhoff interior) is NAMED-NOT-READ here and not relied on.
STANDS: Jacobi initial data A = 0, A' = I at the source point and conjugate detection at det A <= 0 (concentric.py:198-214) match Gao-Wald eqs.(11)-(12) (conjugate iff det A = 0).

lacked_data: M's hypothesis tested for this result: the Jacobi equation and the Ricci-trace / Weyl-trace-free split are geometric identities (Kar-SenGupta p.11: 'not equations but, essentially, identities'); they use NO measured datum, so no later datum can move them. The only physical quantity that could have been 'lacking' in 1961 is Lambda, measured since 1998; R_kk = Lambda g(k,k) = 0 for null k, so it does not move the conclusion. The one later development that does qualify the result is theoretical, not data: Wall 2010 (READ, abstract) shows the sign-definite sigma^2 term can go negative once the graviton is quantized -- the classical Weyl-focusing statement the tree uses is unaffected. Evidence either way, then: nothing the authors lacked changes the result. What the audit did find is on the tree's side: (i) the vacuum test at concentric.py:186 drops the null hypothesis, so 'traceless to 7.5e-4' is a recipe artefact (7.3e-3 on a null screen, dominated by the linearisation's O(m^2)); (ii) the Jacobi integration carries the opposite sign to the Jacobi equation, invisible except as a 0.2 shift (0.09 %) at m = 5e-3 because T is nearly traceless. Neither moves a seat/no-seat verdict: the independent integration reproduces every row (none at 3e-3; 228.7, 182.3, 165.4, 158.1, 154.5), and specthm's 'mu = 5e-3 is concentric's SEAT+LEAD edge; no seat at 0.6 mu' is independently confirmed for the seating half (no conjugate point within L = 300 at 3e-3; one at 228.7 at 5e-3).
grade_evidence: The external result itself is not in question: the Jacobi equation with point-source data and det A = 0 conjugacy (Gao-Wald eqs.11-12, READ), the null Raychaudhuri/Sachs expansion equation (Gao-Wald eq.13, Kar-SenGupta eq.17, READ), the split tr T = R_kk / trace-free = Weyl (sibling V1 proof; J2 here on the tree's metric), and 'Weyl area focusing is quadratic and sign-blind' (J1) all re-derive. It is graded NARROWED because the tree applies it with a hypothesis dropped: concentric.trace_ratio (concentric.py:186) uses k = (1,1,0,0), which is not null (g(k,k) = -4 Phi = -1.99e-2), so the identity 'trace = R_kk, zero in vacuum' does not license reading its output as 'how empty the corridor is' (concentric.py:183-184). Computed: on an exactly null orthonormal screen the a = 0.02 ratio is 7.317e-3, ~9.7x the quoted 7.55e-4, and made of the O(m) core density (7.81e-4) plus the linearised metric's O(m^2) trace -4m^2/b^4 (6.67e-3). The claims resting on it: concentric's VERDICT 'traceless to 7.5e-4' (concentric.py:356) is recipe-dependent -- a DISCREPANCY, not a refutation, and within the tree's named limitation 2; 'compact core => vacuum corridor' as a density criterion stands (monotone on both recipes); 'the shell does not focus' stands (J3); the conjugate points stand to <= 0.25 (0.1 %) against an independent integration and geodesic-bundle truth, the residual being a sign convention in composite.tidal (J5-J6), again a discrepancy; specthm:R4's 'mu IS the SEAT+LEAD edge' is confirmed for its seating half (no seat at 3e-3, seat at 5e-3; the lead half is not this result's and is withdrawn as global in concentric.py itself). Recorded, nothing repaired, none quoted as an error of the source.
what_would_change_the_grade: To STANDS: the vacuum test evaluated on an exactly null k with orthonormal screen (the source's hypothesis), with the O(m^2) linearisation trace reported as such -- the external result would then be used exactly as stated. To OPEN: if the re-derivation (J1-J6) and the sibling V1 proof failed to run and only the unread Sachs 1961 text remained. Nothing found here would move it to WRONG: no counterexample to the identity exists (it is proved for all 4D curvature tensors), and every tree-side discrepancy is below the seat/no-seat threshold. A strong-field (exact GR) treatment of the core, which the tree names as its weakest point (concentric.py:139-141), was not attempted and could move the window edges but not the identity.
